rationale: Both candidates independently surface the two real ground-truth concerns (audio_vae.py:141 config mutation, serving_speech.py language/dialect drop) and correctly validate the patch_emission.py +2 offset against the vendor rationale; Y additionally catches the metrics/definitions.py layering note (hsliuustc0106's 'refactor the env in the next release') that X misses. Y's report is tighter and better synthesized — it ties the double sample-rate-conversion bug directly to WER non-reproducibility with concrete math, flags a real ripple effect (voice_presets caching non-deterministic latents across restarts), and orders findings by severity without repetition. X repeats the same 3-4 findings three times across 'Validated', main body, and 'Additional observations', and pads the report with WER-percentage/issue-number ledger entries not grounded in the given diff or ground truth, hurting precision despite comparable actionability (both give concrete file:line suggestions).
